assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for an original top-down 2D pixel art fantasy RPG. TRANSPARENT background. Precisely 3 columns x 2 rows with six separate isolated environment props, evenly spaced on a 1536 x 1024 canvas, each asset fully contained inside its 512x512 cell with generous clear margin; no grid lines, text, labels, borders, characters, or background. Camera high three-quarter front/top view consistent across all props, like classic 32px-tile detailed pixel RPG environments. Crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no gradients, dark one-pixel outlines, rich but limited palette, clearly readable large forms and controlled clustered textures. Top left: huge ancient gnarled hollow tree with olive foliage and two ochre root buttresses, a dark arched opening at its base and a stone stair descending into the opening, a small amber lantern attached, central village dungeon entrance landmark. Top middle: a cluster of three giant bioluminescent teal and turquoise mushrooms, long ivory stems, dark brown soil/root base, intricate ribbed caps, smallest cap at front, cave decoration. Top right: broken limestone cavern arch entwined by thick dark ochre roots, framing a deep black entrance with a few teal crystals, no square background behind it. Bottom left: three angular blue green crystal columns with a rugged dark rocky base, bright small cream facets. Bottom middle: a tall ochre-brown layered stalagmite cluster with a broad base and narrow pointed tops, detailed stratified rock faces and deep shadows, no lava. Bottom right: ruined underground expedition checkpoint: low stone arch, descending stone stairs, two weathered wooden support pillars, hanging amber lanterns. All props entirely visible and spatially separated with transparency between. Original designs inspired by the atmosphere of a mossy underground world, not copies of existing game artwork.
assets.edit: Six transparent cutouts; retained original generated alpha and authored per-prop sprite rectangles at runtime. Requested clear background and reduced spacing on second edit.

assets.prompt: Original production pixel-art texture for a polished top-down fantasy RPG cavern ground, one seamless repeatable square tile, 1024x1024. Camera straight top down orthographic ground only, fills entire image edge-to-edge. An old underground trail of irregular broad dark slate slabs partially embedded in compact warm grey-brown damp earth, thin broken fissures between several medium stones, occasional tiny olive moss growing in crevices. Floor is mostly continuous compact dirt with restrained small stone patches, naturally varied non-circular worn footpaths but no concentric shapes or rings. Colors low-saturation mineral charcoal-grey, umber and grey taupe, broad readable medium forms; dark cracks lowcontrast enough to keep the floor traversable and spritecharacters distinct. Beautiful carefully arranged pixel clusters at logical 256px art resolution upscaled4x nearestneighbor into1024: hard stepped pixel edges, subtle rich 5tone shading, no blur or smoothgradient, no noisy grain. Big rocks not tilesquares or brick walls. No props, no boulders, no plants except sparse moss, no stairs, no text, no decorative border, no vignette, no lighting pools, no characters, no UI. All four edges should repeat naturally with matching texture tone. Consistent overall medium-dark value. Crafted gamefloorasset, not a scene illustration.

Original seamless material texture, detailed 2D pixel-art RPG cave WALL FACE viewed from front, square 1024x1024 full-bleed repeating rock surface. Dark slate limestone and warm charcoal basalt naturally layered into broad irregular fractured rock masses, vertical split faces, broken edges catching a few subdued grey-green highlights, deep narrow shadow crevices. Believable geological large and medium forms, connected contours and shaded facets, moss in a very few wet cracks. Consistent muted gray-brown-green palette, low saturation, medium-dark value. Restrained cluster pixel rendering, logical 256x256 pixel grid upscaled 4x nearestneighbor; hard readable edges with five shade bands per surface. No shiny ores, no lava, no fungus, no plants, no floor, no sky, no scene or separate boulders, no props, no bricks or orderly masonry, no text, no labels, no vignette, no gradients, no blur. Nothing outlined as a rectangular panel. Edges should tile seamlessly. This wall material will be mapped onto continuous cave contours behind a top-down pixel RPG character.
